1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Industri Perkhidmatan Air (Pengkompaunan Kesalahan) (Pindaan) 2022.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 April 2022.

Pindaan peraturan 2

2. Peraturan-Peraturan Industri Perkhidmatan Air (Pengkompaunan Kesalahan) 2008

[P.U. (A) 259/2008], yang disebut "Peraturan-Peraturan ibu" dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini,

dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 2 dengan peraturan yang berikut:

"Kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun

2. (1) Kesalahan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama ditetapkan

sebagai kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun.

(2) Kesalahan yang disebut dalam subperaturan (1) boleh dikompaun

dengan keizinan Pendakwa Raya secara bertulis dalam Borang 1 Jadual Kedua.".

Pindaan peraturan 3

3. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 3 dengan

peraturan yang berikut:

"Tawaran dan penyetujuterimaan kompaun

3. (1) Sesuatu tawaran untuk mengkompaun kesalahan yang boleh

dikompaun hendaklah dibuat dalam Borang 2 Jadual Kedua.

(2) Seseorang yang menyetuju terima tawaran untuk mengkompaun

sesuatu kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun hendaklah menyetuju terima tawaran

itu dalam Borang 3 Jadual Kedua dan mengembalikan Borang itu kepada

Suruhanjaya.".

Pindaan peraturan 4

4. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dalam peraturan 4—

(a) dalam subperaturan (1)―

(i) dengan memotong perkataan "dibuat dan"; dan

(ii) dengan memasukkan selepas perkataan "draf bank" perkataan

"yang kena dibayar"; dan

(b) dalam subperaturan (2), dengan menggantikan perkataan

"pos berbayar dahulu" dengan perkataan "pos berdaftar berbayar dahulu".

Penggantian Jadual

5. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan Jadual dengan jadual

yang berikut:

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY ACT 2006

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY (COMPOUNDING OF OFFENCES)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 163(1) and paragraph 179(g) of the

Water Services Industry Act 2006 [Act 655], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Water Services Industry

(Compounding of Offences) (Amendment) Regulations 2022.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 April 2022.

Amendment of regulation 2

2. The Water Services Industry (Compounding of Offences) Regulations 2008

[P.U. (A) 259/2008], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these

Regulations, are amended by substituting for regulation 2 the following

regulation:

"Offences which may be compounded

2. (1) The offences specified in the First Schedule are prescribed

as offences which may be compounded.

(2) The offences referred to in subregulation (1) may be

compounded with the consent in writing of the Public Prosecutor in Form 1

of the Second Schedule.".

Amendment of regulation 3

3. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 3

the following regulation:

"Offer and acceptance of compound

3. (1) An offer to compound offences which may be compounded

shall be made in Form 2 of the Second Schedule.

(2) A person who accepts an offer to compound offences which

may be compounded shall accept the offer in Form 3 of the Second Schedule

and return the Form to the Commission.".

Amendment of regulation 4

4. The principal Regulations are amended in regulation 4―

(a) in subregulation (1)―

(i) by deleting the words "made and"; and

(ii) by inserting after the words "bank draft" the words "made payable"; and

(b) in subregulation (2), by substituting for the words "prepaid post"

the words "prepaid registered post".

Substitution of the Schedule

following schedules:
